691: People who serve kings who are quick to anger should act like people warming themselves by a fire. They should not go too far away or too close.
707: Is anything wiser than the face? Whether a person is happy or angry, the face shows it first.
711: People with pure minds who know words well should first understand the group they are speaking to, and then speak with care.
721: People with pure minds who know words well and understand their listeners will not stumble when they speak before a powerful group.
769: An army will win if its numbers are not shrinking, its soldiers do not hold a lasting grudge, and it is not short of supplies.
